Class SpatialUtil

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.SpatialUtil
public class SpatialUtil extends Object
A class which offers some custom methods for the Spatial view.

    • setPlotView

      public static void setPlotView(boolean plotView)

    • setPlotTitle

      public static void setPlotTitle(String title)
      Sets the title of the plot view (displayed at the top of the 3D view).

      The texts of the plot view (the title, the axis titles and the legends) can contain a simple math markup: x^2, x^-0.5 or x^{n+1} for superscripts, N_0 or N_{max} for subscripts (\\^ and \\_ for the characters). Greek letters and symbols can be written as Unicode characters (e.g., α for alpha, · for a dot).

      Parameters:
      title - the title (lines separated with \n) or null (no title)

    • setLogAxes

      public static void setLogAxes(boolean x, boolean y, boolean z)
      Selects logarithmic axes of the plot view. The data of a logarithmic axis are drawn as log10 values (e.g., Math.log10(value)) and the numbers of the axis are the values (10^v, e.g., 100, 1e5, 1.34e10) with minor ticks and grid lines at 2, 3, ..., 9 times the powers of ten.
      Parameters:
      x - true for a logarithmic x axis
      y - true for a logarithmic y axis
      z - true for a logarithmic z axis

    • setAxisNumberFormats

      public static void setAxisNumberFormats(String x, String y, String z)
      Sets the formats of the numbers of the axes of the plot view (see java.util.Formatter, e.g., "%.2e" for 1.34e+10, "%.1f" or "%,.0f"). By default (null) the numbers are formatted automatically: very large or small numbers in a scientific notation (e.g., 1.34e10, 2.5e-6). The format "10^" displays the numbers as powers of ten with superscripts (e.g., 10^3, 1.34x10^10), e.g., for logarithmic axes.
      Parameters:
      x - the format of the x axis (null = automatic)
      y - the format of the y axis (null = automatic)
      z - the format of the z axis (null = automatic)

    • setAxisRanges

      public static void setAxisRanges(double x0, double x1, double y0, double y1, double z0, double z1)
      Sets the values of the axis numbers of the plot view at the data bounds (see setDataBounds). The three axes of the 3D view have the same scale. For data with different units and ranges (e.g., the time in hours and cell counts up to 1e10) the data is drawn in the coordinates of the box (e.g., 0 - 10 for all axes) and the axis numbers display the values of the data (a linear mapping of the bounds to the values). For a logarithmic axis the values are log10 values.
      Parameters:
      x0 - the value at the minimum x of the bounds
      x1 - the value at the maximum x of the bounds
      y0 - the value at the minimum y of the bounds
      y1 - the value at the maximum y of the bounds
      z0 - the value at the minimum z of the bounds
      z1 - the value at the maximum z of the bounds

    • setLegend

    • setColorBar

      public static void setColorBar(String title, double min, double max, int[] colors)
      Displays a color bar at the right side of the 3D view: a color ramp with the numbers of the values (e.g., the heights of a surface). The colors are evenly distributed from the minimum to the maximum (see PlotLegend.rampColor to draw the data with the same colors and the ramps PlotLegend.VIRIDIS, RAINBOW, DIVERGING, TERRAIN).
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the color bar (e.g., the name and the unit)
      min - the value of the first color
      max - the value of the last color
      colors - the colors of the ramp (0xRRGGBB)

    • setColorBar

      public static void setColorBar(String title, double min, double max, int[] colors, boolean log, String format)
      Displays a color bar at the right side of the 3D view (see setColorBar(String, double, double, int[])) with logarithmic values or a format of the numbers.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the color bar
      min - the value of the first color (a log10 value if log)
      max - the value of the last color (a log10 value if log)
      colors - the colors of the ramp (0xRRGGBB)
      log - true if min and max are log10 values (the numbers are 10^v)
      format - the format of the numbers (java.util.Formatter, e.g., "%.1f", "10^" for powers of ten, null = automatic, e.g., 1.34e10)

    • isMainViewDrawing

      public static boolean isMainViewDrawing()
      Returns true while the first view of a frame is drawn: the main view (false for the small view of the split view and for the second eye of the stereo view). Something which should be done once per frame (e.g., an overlay) can be guarded with it. A step of a model is guarded already with canStep (true only in the first view of a frame).
      Returns:
      true while the first view of a frame is drawn

    • isSplitPanelDrawing

      public static boolean isSplitPanelDrawing()
      Returns true while the small view of the split view is drawn (false without the split view). Something which should be drawn only in the main view (e.g., an overlay) can be skipped with it.
      Returns:
      true while the small view is drawn

    • canStep

      public static boolean canStep()
      This method returns a boolean which is triggered by the UI slider to adjust a frame rate. It is true only in the first view of a frame (not again in the small view of the split view or for the second eye of the stereo view), so a step of a model guarded with it is computed once per frame.
      Returns:
      a boolean value.
